# TİSYA

> TİSYA is a global student-led alliance. Pick a path — Pathfinder, Pioneer, Ambassador, or Partner — and join the movement.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of TİSYA and entry point to join.
- [Roles](/roles): Choose your path within the Alliance.
- [Pathfinder mission](/mission/members): Briefing for Pathfinder (Member) applicants.
- [Pioneer mission](/mission/pioneers): Briefing for Pioneer (Volunteer) applicants.
- [Ambassador mission](/mission/ambassador): Briefing for Ambassador applicants.
- [Partner mission](/mission/partner): Briefing for Partner / Sponsor applicants.

## Optional

- [Join Pathfinder](/join/members): Application form for Pathfinders.
- [Join Pioneer](/join/pioneers): Application form for Pioneers.
- [Join Ambassador](/join/ambassador): Application form for Ambassadors.
- [Join Partner](/join/partner): Application form for Partners.
